Shooting in Northern Germany Leaves Multiple Dead, Suspects Arrested

A shooting incident occurred in Stade, northern Germany, resulting in the deaths of either five or six people, according to different reports. Police have arrested two individuals in connection with the event. One report specifies the shooting took place at a youth center, while another indicates it occurred at a mother and child shelter. The suspect is described as a Muslim man in one report.
